title: Site Migration
subtitle: Move sites from a cPanel, Plesk or DirectAdmin server to this panel in three steps, together with their files, databases, DNS and SSL. The job runs in the background, so you can close this page.

step1.title: Source server details
step1.description: SSH details of the server that holds the sites. The credentials are stored encrypted and are deleted once the job finishes.
step1.credentialNote: Credentials are stored with AES encryption and deleted automatically when the migration ends.
step1.panelMismatch: (this does not match the panel you selected)

step2.title: Sites to migrate
step2.settingsDescription: Choose what is migrated, which plan applies and who owns the result.
step2.overwriteWarning: Caution: "Overwrite the existing site" is on. The files and databases of any site with the same domain will be written over. Take a backup first.

files.label: Files
files.hint: The web root is copied with rsync

databases.label: Databases
databases.hint: A dump is taken, imported, and the site configuration is updated

dns.label: DNS records
dns.hint: The source zone is read and the A records are pointed here

overwrite.label: Overwrite the existing site
overwrite.hint: Writes over a site that already uses the same domain

resume.title: Resume a migration you started earlier
resume.usingStored: The saved credentials will be used; you do not need to enter the password again.

errors.noSitesFound: No migratable site was found on the source server.
errors.startFailed: The migration could not be started
errors.cancelFailed: The job could not be cancelled
errors.resumeFailed: The migration could not be resumed.
errors.forgetFailed: The saved migration could not be removed.
